title: POST /v0.1/spheres/{sphere}/owners/{owner}/rebind request
description: Get back into an Obysphere with a sign-in (feature owner_rebind, sphere-api.md section 3.2): bind a new owner key to the owner, revoking the old key's agents. The sign-in, started for owner_key, is the authentication. A card, signed by the new key, adds a new agent of the owner in the same step.

owner_key.description: The new owner key, the one the sign-in was started for.

card.description: Optional: a new agent's card for this owner, signed by owner_key, joined as by redeem (section 4, checks 3, 4 and 6 to 8).
